patterns.name: meta.statement.setting.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
    ^[ \t]*
    (pool_\w+\b) # a key that starts with `pool`
    \s* (=) \s*  # kvp separator surrounded by optional whitespace
    ([^\r\n]+)   # match anything on the right-hand-side
    (?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.section.shader-regex.migoto
patterns.begin:
(?xi)
(?<!^[ \t]*\[\s*ShaderRegex.+(?:\.Pattern.*|\.InsertDeclarations)\s*\][ \t]*(?:[;#].*)?$) # Ensure this is not one of the other 3
^[ \t]*(\[)\s*(ShaderRegex[^\r\n\]]+)\s*(\])[ \t]*(?:(([;#]).*))?$

patterns.name: meta.statement.setting.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]*
(?!\b(?:
  key|back|hash|[vhdgpc]s|(?:blend|alpha)(?:\[\d+\])?|
  (?:override|cache|storage)_directory|include(?:_recursive)?|exclude_recursive|
  (?:done_|toggle_)hunting|next_marking_mode|mark_snapshot|
  (?:previous|next|mark)_(?:pixel|vertex|compute|geometry|domain|hull)shader|
  (?:previous|next|mark)_(?:index|vertex)buffer|(?:previous|next)_(?:index|vertex)buffer_slot|
  (?:previous|next|mark)_rendertarget|
  take_screenshot|reload_fixes|(?:reload|wipe_user)_config|show_original|
  monitor_performance|freeze_performance_monitor|tune[123]_(?:up|down)|
  analyse_frame|toggle_full_screen|force_full_screen_on_key|toggle_input|
  run|checktextureoverride|(?:exclude_)?preset|handling|clear|special|dump|store|
  draw(?:indexed|instanced|indexedinstanced|instancedindirect|indexedinstancedindirect)?|dispatch(?:indirect)?|
  vb\d|ib|(?:[rf]_)?bb|s?o\d|od|
  (?<!$)[xyzw]\d{0,3}|
  this|(?:ini|stereo)params|cursor_(?:mask|color)|
  (?:Resource|Pool).+
)\b)        # ^ exclusions to resolve conflicts or handle special cases
([\w\[\]]+) # a word-like that is not in the preceding list and includes brackets for blend[N]/blend_factor[N] keys
\s* (=) \s* # kvp separator surrounded by optional whitespace
([^\r\n]+)  # match anything on the right-hand-side
(?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.statement.setting.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]*
\b(
  (?:done_|toggle_)hunting | next_marking_mode | mark_snapshot |
  (?:previous|next|mark)_(?:pixel|vertex|compute|geometry|domain|hull)shader |
  (?:previous|next|mark)_(?:index|vertex)buffer | (?:previous|next)_(?:index|vertex)buffer_slot |
  (?:previous|next|mark)_rendertarget | key | back |
  take_screenshot | reload_fixes | (?:reload|wipe_user)_config | show_original |
  monitor_performance | freeze_performance_monitor | tune[123]_(?:up|down) |
  analyse_frame | toggle_full_screen | force_full_screen_on_key | toggle_input
)\b         # ^^^ keys that take KeyBinding as a value
\s* (=) \s* # kvp separator surrounded by optional whitespace
([^\r\n]+)  # RHS value, open to accommodate symbols
[ \t]*
(?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.statement.setting.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]*
\b((?:override|cache|storage)_directory|include(?:_recursive)?|exclude_recursive)\b
\s* (=) \s* # kvp separator surrounded by optional whitespace
([^\r\n]+)  # match anything on the right-hand-side
[ \t]*
(?:$|\n)

global-declaration.name: meta.statement.declaration.global.migoto
global-declaration.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]*
(?:(persist|locked)\s+)?
(global)\s+
(?:(persist|locked)\s+)?
(\$\w+)\b
\s*
(?:
  (=) \s* # assignment operator, surrounded by optional whitespace
  ([^\r\n]+)
)? # Assignment operator and RHS-value are optional, e.g. `global $variable` on a line by itself
\s*
(?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.statement.assignment.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]* # optional leading whitespace
(?:(pre|post)\s+)? # pre and post modifiers, optional
(?= \$ | \b[xyzw]\d{0,3}\b ) ([^=\r\n]+) # a $ variable or an ini parameter
\s*
(=) # assignment operator, surrounded by optional whitespace
\s*
([^\r\n]+) # operational expression
(?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.statement.assignment.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]* # optional leading whitespace
(?:(pre|post)\s+)? # pre and post modifiers, optional
(?= commandlist ) ([^=\r\n]+\b) # a callable commandlist name
\s*
(=) # assignment operator, surrounded by optional whitespace
\s*
([^\r\n]+) # commandlist proxy expression
(?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.statement.assignment.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]* # optional leading whitespace
(?:(pre|post)\s+)? # pre and post modifiers, optional
( [^\r\n]+ -> \w+\( .+ \) ) # a property access method call
\s*
(=) # assignment operator, surrounded by optional whitespace
\s*
([^\r\n]+) # dgxi format or an integer
(?:$|\n)

patterns.name: meta.statement.assignment.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]* # optional leading whitespace
(?:(pre|post)\s+)? # pre and post modifiers, optional
\b(
  [vgdhpcsturfibo\-\d_]+\b |
  this\b | (?:ini|stereo)params\b | cursor_(?:mask|color)\b |
  (?: Resource | Pool ) [^=\r\n]+
)   # a resource operand
\s*
(=) # assignment operator, surrounded by optional whitespace
\s*
([^\r\n]+) # resource usage expression
(?:$|\n)

instruction-statement.name: meta.statement.instruction.migoto
instruction-statement.match:
(?xi)
^[ \t]* # optional leading whitespace
(?:(pre|post)\s+)? # pre and post modifiers, optional
(?:
  (
    \b\w+\b # an instruction
    \s*
    = # execution operator, surrounded by optional whitespace
    \s*
    [^\r\n]+ # RHS value, depends on type of instruction
  ) |
  (drawauto) # an instruction with no RHS
)
(?:$|\n)

fuzzy-match-expression.name: meta.expression.fuzzy-match.migoto
fuzzy-match-expression.match:
(?xi)
(?:
  ([><]=?|[!=]) \s* \b (\d+) \b | # an integer w/ operator
  ([><]=?|[!=])? # optional operator
  \s*
  (?:
    \b ((?:res_)?(?:width|height)|depth|array) \b # field name
    \s*
    (?:
      (?:(\*)\s*\b((?:res_)?(?:width|height)|depth|array)\b) |
      (?:(\*)\s*\b(\d+)\b)? # integer multiplicand
      \s*
      (?:(/)\s*\b(\d+)\b)? # integer divisor
    )
  ) # field expression
)
\s*$

operator.match:
(?xi)
(?:
  ( \*\* | \* | \+ | - | % | // | / ) |       # arithmetic operators
  ( >> | << ) |                               # bit shift operators
  ( !== | != | === | == | >= | <= | > | < ) | # comparison operators
  ( ! | && | \|\| ) |                         # logical operators
  ( ~ | & | \| | ^ ) |                        # bitwise operators
  ( @ ) | ( \# )                              # identity and index/size operators
)

patterns.name: constant.language.runtime-parameter.migoto
patterns.match:
(?xi)
\b(
  (?:rt|res|window)_(?:width|height) | (?:vertex|index|instance)_count | first_(?:vertex|index|instance) |
  thread_group_count_[xyz] | indirect_offset | draw_type | cursor_(?: showing | (?:screen_|window_|hotspot_)?[xy] ) |
  time | hunting | sli | frame_analysis | effective_dpi | (?:raw_|eye_)?separation | convergence |
  stereo_(?:active|available) | scissor_(?:left|top|right|bottom) |
  (?:frame|dispatch|draw)_number | frame_time | fps
)\b
